Subject: Unexpected invoice item for trial usage / VAT on free credits

Hi Marissa,

We signed up via the self-serve flow last week and were issued the PLG trial credits. Today we received invoice INV-55621 which shows token usage billed and a VAT line — can you explain why we were charged when we thought the trial credits would cover our usage?

I attached a PDF of the invoice. The invoice shows a positive charge for token consumption and then VAT at 20%. There is also a line that reads “Promo credit applied: -€0.00” which looks like the credit was not applied.

Two quick questions: 1) Were our free credits ever issued correctly on your end? 2) If they were issued, why did the invoice process as a charge?

Please let me know as this blocks our finance team from reconciling. If helpful, account id is ATLAS-1947.

Thanks,
Jules Park

Hi Jules / Marissa,

I pulled the billing and grant records for ATLAS-1947. Summary below:

1) Credit issuance: a self-serve promo (grant id G-20271102-AT) was created on 2027-11-02T14:20:11Z and tied to ATLAS-1947 for 30 days (3,000,000 tokens). On our side the grant shows as CREATED and PENDING_ASSOCIATION for 4 minutes, then ASSOCIATED.

2) Invoice timing: Invoice INV-55621 closed on 2027-11-09T23:59:59Z (UTC) for the billing period ending 11/09. We see a small window where usage occurred and the invoice process kicked off before a late webhook reconciled the grant association for two of the token lines — result: the invoice line items show positive token charges and a promo credit line with zero value because the credit association reconciliation happened after the invoice snapshot was taken.

3) VAT: Because Atlas Labs' billing address is in the EU and our current tax treatment records credits as a reduction of consideration (not an exempt supply), VAT was calculated on the gross invoice before the subsequent grant reconciliation. When we apply the credit as a post-invoice adjustment, the payment record shows the original VAT amount.

Proposed remedy (pending manager approval):
- Create a credit memo reversing the charged token amount on INV-55621 and apply an adjusted invoice so the VAT is recalculated to reflect the credit. This will result in either a net-zero due invoice or a refund for any net payment already taken.
- As a customer experience gesture, we can issue a 30-day extension of the trial credits and add an extra 250k token courtesy credit to cover any disruption.

Attachments: I attached the credits_issuance_log.csv which shows timestamps and the reconciliation event.

Questions for Atlas: please confirm whether a refund is acceptable or if you prefer a credit memo and invoice adjustment for accounting purposes. Also confirm whether finance@atlaslabs.ai should be copied on the resolution for their records.

Thanks — Marissa, I’m leaving the final sign-off to Laura for the courtesy extension / promo.

—Rishi
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
